modes.title: Lungi
modes.description: Embark on an epic pirate adventure across vast oceans and uncharted islands. Build your ship, recruit a crew, and plunder your way to legendary status. Trade with merchants, battle rival pirates, and discover ancient treasures hidden deep within mysterious caves.
gallery: Sailing the open seas at sunset

modes.title: Sea Battle
modes.description: Command powerful warships in intense naval battles. Coordinate with your fleet, outmaneuver your enemies, and dominate the seas. Coming soon with full fleet management, ranked matchmaking, and seasonal tournaments.

modes.title: Treasure Islands
modes.description: Discover procedurally generated islands filled with puzzles, traps, and legendary loot. Each island is unique — solve ancient riddles, navigate deadly dungeons, and race other players to claim the treasure before it vanishes.
